title: David L Wade & Associates
description:
David L. Wade and Associates, P.C. is an accounting firm based in Fort Wayne, IN, specializing 
in a wide range of services for both individuals and businesses. Their offerings include person
al financial planning, tax preparation, bookkeeping, payroll, and QuickBooks services, aimed at
helping clients navigate complex tax laws and improve financial management.
